bindingFaults: MON-282-W1-A2's binding refusals (a missing, unnamed, digest-mismatched, malformed, miscounted or duplicated hunk-class record, a named one that is a link, not a file, or unreadable, a rule digest the reader does not hold, and an authority that carries classes itself) and a reordered record are class A, kind input; they are sourced in architecture/chain-checkpoint/README.md (How the reader rebuilds) and the module tests, with no vector of their own (P047-C6-4)
countEffectTable: architecture/chain-checkpoint/README.md, the countEffect table: every kind a vector expects takes its class and countEffect from it
hunkClassRecords: architecture/chain-checkpoint/hunk-classes/<slot>.json (MON-282-W1-A2): every vector that classes an authority's hunks builds the authority in v2.1's form and its closed hunk-class record, which the authority's newFiles names by sha256

vectors.case: change data<slot>.txt (or the layer authority) after the record is written
vectors.expectDetail: an input, or the layer's authority, differs from its checkpoint digest; the file is listed as unauthored (P047-C3-4); a JSON change that keeps the layer authority an object, with baselinePackets, changedFiles and newFiles objects, is class A; one that stops it parsing, or makes it or one of those three members a non-object, makes the reading corrupt with a null slot (Q-R4-2, P047-C5-3)
vectors.name: tampered attested file
vectors.names: the layer's slot and the file

vectors.case: omit the record from every authority; or add a newer authority naming a different afterSha256
vectors.expectDetail: no authority names record.json, or the newest naming authority names another digest
vectors.name: unnamed or stale ledger

vectors.case: report call=failed for a node the ledger records as passed
vectors.expectDetail: a node's live outcome differs from the ledger with no input change
vectors.name: sample refusal

vectors.case: MODE = "sampled" in ci/chain_checkpoint.py; OUT_DIR under the worktree
vectors.expectDetail: the writer refuses a reader whose MODE is not shadow, and an OUT_DIR inside the worktree
vectors.name: checkpoint from an attested run

vectors.case: ids [A, A]; type unruled; one entry twice
vectors.expectDetail: a self-paired, unruled or repeated check_pairs entry
vectors.name: check_pairs defect

vectors.case: sample(tree, slots, 0.1) twice and for another tree
vectors.expectDetail: one head tree draws one sample; two trees differ
vectors.name: sample seed

vectors.case: as vector 3, read from the record's layers and disagreements
vectors.expectDetail: recorded with the slot and its class; the session's exit status unchanged
vectors.name: shadow disagreement

vectors.expectDetail: where two layers disagree, the newest slot is recorded first
vectors.name: refusing-layer order

vectors.case: a clock advancing 20 s per tick; parameters.shadowIn = dryRunOnly with an END-event log
vectors.expectDetail: the budget stops the replay over 15 s (kind over-budget); in dryRunOnly an in-session reading is skipped (kind skipped, countEffect neutral, its slot the head's, naming the head slot and the checkpoint slot) and the runner's dry-run-compare compares
vectors.name: cost cap and dry-run-only

vectors.case: the conftest's load and three hooks each catch Exception
vectors.expectDetail: a missing, unloadable or raising reader prints one class-C line; exit status unchanged
vectors.name: guarded load

vectors.case: architecture/authority-map-authority.json, classed by the rule under MET-ADOPT-007's context
vectors.expectDetail: 281's edited files rebuild to each beforeSha256 under 281's context; validate_readiness's block and the master plan's status line rebuild too, as class register (chainmech v2.3, MON-282-W2-RULED); a file that a later slot edits for real (every unexplained hunk of a class not normalised) is counted apart, and a file whose only miss is at its newest recorded step is pending, unauthored: counted and printed, and zero in every runner execution (HARNESS_OFFLINE_ENFORCED=1)
vectors.name: a K = 0 cascade step reads clean

vectors.case: the live validator is the authority's after bytes plus one byte
vectors.expectDetail: one extra byte beside a cascade hunk: afterSha256 differs, recorded cascade share x of N; the file is unauthored
vectors.name: one byte beside the cascade

vectors.expectDetail: a hunk out of order or not applying byte-exactly
vectors.name: reordered or missing hunk

vectors.case: the ledger's exclusion names the head validator as pinLine; change only its AUTHORITY_SHA256 line, then any other line
vectors.expectDetail: a pin-line-only change reads clean (the file is attested with that line normalised to TO_BE_PINNED_AFTER_SOURCE_FREEZE); any other edit of the validator differs from its checkpoint digest (class A, kind input)
vectors.name: the head validator's pin line
vectors.names: the layer's slot and the file
